correctness.rationale: For words with no aa, once b occurs, the only possible images are S={1,…,n−1} and T=Q∖{1}, with Sb=S, Sa=T, and Tb=S; after reaching T another a is forbidden. Hence the minimum rank is exactly n−1 and cannot be one for n≥3. On S, x=ab is increment modulo N=n−1. The block y=aab acts as x² except at N, which maps to 1 instead of 2. Therefore e=yx^(N−2) fixes 1,…,N−1 and maps N to N−1, also when N=2 and the exponent is zero. After be, xe shrinks the interval [j,N−1] to [j+1,N−1] until singleton. All blocks end in b, with runs of at most two rotations. Direct counting gives 2n²−5n+1. The classical unconstrained lower bound gives quadratic growth, not exact optimality of this word. Independent bit-mask subset/constraint BFS (python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 4) found no cap-one reset for n=3,…,12, verified the witness for those sizes, and found cap-two minima 4,11,20,33,48,67,88,113,140,171. This range also independently agrees with the closest indexed stronger formula, not a proof of that formula for all n. Frozen verify.py inspected, not executed.
